**Global Polio Eradication Initiative** **Overview and Historical Context** - *1988 World Health Assembly Resolution*: Initiated the global mandate to eradicate poliomyelitis. - *Progress*: Endemic countries reduced from over 125 in 1988 to 3 in 2014 (*Afghanistan*, *Pakistan*, and *Nigeria*). - *Eradication Status*: 80% of the global population resides in certified polio-free regions. - *Wild Poliovirus (WPV) Strains*: - *Type 2*: Eradicated in 1999. - *Type 3*: Last reported case in November 2012. **Polio Eradication and Endgame Strategic Plan (2013-2018)** This comprehensive strategy aims to eliminate all polio disease, including WPV and *vaccine-derived poliovirus* (VDPV).

**1. Transmission Interruption** Stop all WPV transmission; enhance surveillance; ensure rapid outbreak response for VDPV within 6 months.
**2. Immunization & OPV Withdrawal** Replace *trivalent OPV* with *bivalent OPV* by mid-2016; introduce *Inactivated Polio Vaccine (IPV)*; eventual total removal of OPV to eliminate VDPV risks.
